login.title: User login
login.description:
Please enter a username and password. The login credentials are only used for the initial data query and are not stored.
Also set the interval for data queries outside and during active alarms.

api_key.title: Enter API key
api_key.description: If the login fails or a system user should be logged in, the user's API key can be entered here as an alternative.

multi_cluster.title: Select unit
multi_cluster.description: Multiple units were found for the entered user. Please select the desired unit. Additional units must be added separately.

reconfigure.title: Change configuration for DiveraControl
reconfigure.description: By changing the API key, a different user can be assigned to the unit. Additionally, both intervals can be reconfigured.

breaking_changes_v1_2_0.title: Action required: **{cluster_name}**
breaking_changes_v1_2_0.description:
You have upgraded DiveraControl for **{cluster_name}** from version 1.1 or earlier to version 1.2.0.

**Important:** This version includes breaking changes in all service calls and device actions.

**What you need to do:**
1. Review all automations that use DiveraControl services
2. Check all device actions in your automations
3. Update the parameter names according to the new schema
4. Test all automations and other service calls to ensure functionality

**Note:** This notification will remain until you dismiss it after reviewing your automations.

migration_failed_v2_0_0.title: Migration failed: **{cluster_name}**
migration_failed_v2_0_0.description:
An attempt was made to migrate the configuration of **{cluster_name}** to version 2.0.0, but it failed. Please check the logs for details and reconfigure the integration if necessary. Easiest way would be to remove and reinstall the integration. 

**Important:** This version includes breaking changes in all service calls and device actions.

**What you need to do:**
1. Review all automations that use DiveraControl services
2. Check all device actions in your automations
3. Update the parameter names according to the new schema
4. Test all automations and other service calls to ensure functionality

**Note:** This notification will remain until you dismiss it after reviewing your automations.

breaking_changes_v2_0_0.title: Action required: **{cluster_name}**
breaking_changes_v2_0_0.description:
You have upgraded DiveraControl for **{cluster_name}** from version 1.2.x or earlier to version 2.0.0.

**Important:** This version includes breaking changes in all service calls and device actions.

**What you need to do:**
1. Review all automations that use DiveraControl services
2. Check all device actions in your automations
3. Update the parameter names according to the new schema
4. Test all automations and other service calls to ensure functionality

**Note:** This notification will remain until you dismiss it after reviewing your automations.
